differences.a_observable: Camera is closer to the grid, framing the 'Live Now' button and cards tightly.
differences.b_observable: Camera is pulled back, showing a much wider view of the grid with smaller elements.
differences.fix: Adjust camera position and focal length to match the tighter framing of the reference.

differences.a_observable: Soft, deep contact shadows are visible under the raised cards, creating depth.
differences.b_observable: Contact shadows are extremely faint, making the cards look flat and ungrounded.
differences.fix: Enable ambient occlusion and adjust shadow settings to deepen contact shadows.

differences.a_observable: The yellow and blue cards display rich, vibrant, and highly saturated colors.
differences.b_observable: The colors on the cards appear washed out and desaturated.
differences.fix: Increase saturation and adjust material colors to match the reference's vibrant look.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera framing and position to match the tighter composition of the reference, and deepen the contact shadows to restore depth.
